answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, join a Semaphore-style membership tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed shares enforce a per-epoch message limit. A zero-knowledge proof validates each message without exposing identity; reusing the same rate-limit slot yields distinct Shamir shares, allowing observers to reconstruct the agent’s private key and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The terrace, falcon, and zenith labels can identify epochs or tiers, not weaken this rule.
